import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_74/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_74/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Operation History: JOIN on ["city", "city"]
# Join df0 and df1 on 'city'
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="city", how="inner")

# Construct the target table with schema: ['city': string, 'type': string, 'fare': float]
# Select and rename columns accordingly
target_df = df_joined[["city", "type", "fare"]].copy()

# Ensure correct data types
target_df["city"] = target_df["city"].astype(str)
target_df["type"] = target_df["type"].astype(str)
target_df["fare"] = target_df["fare"].astype(float)

# Write the result to the specified path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_74/target_multisource.csv"
target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_74/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_74/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on 'city'
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="city", how="inner")

# Group by 'city' and 'type' and aggregate fare by mean
result = joined.groupby(["city", "type"], as_index=False).agg({"fare": "mean"})

# Write output with exact target schema and column names
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_74/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
